title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the rescue party and reads air movement to sense recent presence; he falls through a trapdoor in the floor.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's small spirit companion; she rides his shoulder and chitters warnings, and falls with him.

entities.name: The Wanderer
aliases: Very pleasant swordswoman without a name
entities.description: The former planeswalker Emperor of Kamigawa, who still senses the planes and insists on keeping the party together.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Strixhaven researcher with a monitor who conjures fractal light and is drawn to the House's library.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince who turns his body to wood or stone and runs toward cries for help; he breaks through a wall to find stairs.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Theros with shard magic and labyrinth training who helps the Wanderer search for the rest.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: The missing child the rescue party came to find; his mother was dear to the Wanderer.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's mother, who died in the invasion and is not named on this page; the Wanderer says she was sorry to kill her.

entities.name: Swift-Arm
entities.description: Kaito's trainer, who taught him to read the movement of air.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon on Ravnica whose scanners and help the party hopes to fetch.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A pale, spiky-haired survivor who has lived in the House most of his life and rescues Niko and the Wanderer from a razorkin.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Masked, cleaver-wielding hunters of the House found in the Floodpits that track sounds.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: A shifting, rotting house that rearranges itself when unobserved, plays tricks and, per Winter, is the world.

entities.name: The Floodpits
entities.description: A water-filled area of the House where razorkin live.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The Wanderer's home plane.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Niko's home plane, known for labyrinths.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane the party came from and hopes to return to.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invader that killed Nashi's mother and changed bodies without consent.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that once pulled the Wanderer across without consent.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: A deity of glory whom Niko associates with Tyvar's love of stories.

entities.name: Vorzani Conjecture
entities.description: A theory that the Multiverse seeks observation; Zimone cites it.

events.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
events.quote: The door's gone

events.summary: Zimone realizes the room is not the one Nashi's drone recorded, so the House rearranges itself.
events.quote: This isn't the same room that it recorded.

events.summary: Kaito reads the air in the parlor and concludes someone was recently there.
events.quote: I don't know if Nashi was here recently, but someone was

events.summary: The Wanderer finds a family photo with the adults' faces scratched out and the daughter smiling.
events.quote: The faces of the adults had been scratched out, reduced to white scabs on the paper

events.summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
events.quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

events.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
events.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

events.summary: The Wanderer refuses Kaito's idea of scouting the rooftops, insisting the group stay visible to one another.
events.quote: You were the one who realized we had to stay ever visible to one another.

events.summary: The Wanderer says the House feels like a shell encasing all that remained of the plane, and decides they should return to where the door vanished.
events.quote: This feels like a shell surrounding everything there is of what once was, and I fear it has no limits.

events.summary: A voice cries for help and Tyvar runs toward it; Zimone chases him.
events.quote: Tyvar's thin leash on his own heroic urges snapped, and he took off running

events.summary: Zimone races after Tyvar through the doorway as something shatters beside her head and the ballroom disappears.
events.quote: Something shattered on the doorway next to her head as she ran through

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an empty hall with no one in danger and conclude the House is playing tricks.
events.quote: On the other side of the door was an empty hall.

events.summary: The doorway behind Tyvar and Zimone becomes a solid wall papered with moths, separating them from the others.
events.quote: where the doorway back to the ballroom should have been, was a wall

events.summary: Kaito and Niko realize the doorway moved and skewed Niko's aim, so the trap was deliberate.
events.quote: The doorway moved as Tyvar passed through it.

events.summary: Kaito steps toward the doorway and the floor opens into a toothed mouth; he falls into blackness as the Wanderer fails to catch him.
events.quote: The floor he stepped onto opened like the mouth of a lamprey

events.summary: Niko holds the Wanderer back from jumping after Kaito, and the hole disappears.
events.quote: The Wanderer tensed as if to jump after him, only to stop when Niko grabbed her wrist.

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone discover their hallway has turned into a towering library when they stopped looking.
events.quote: They were no longer in a hallway.

events.summary: Tyvar turns his skin to wood and punches through the wall, finding a stairway beyond.
events.quote: Tyvar's skin rippled, taking on the hardwood sheen of the floor beneath his feet

events.summary: Zimone ties a fractal thread to Tyvar and stays in the library to study the books while he climbs the stairs.
events.quote: I'll keep the other one, and hopefully that means we won't lose each other.

events.summary: Tyvar climbs a stairwell lined with portraits of people distorted into monstrous shapes.
events.quote: The walls of the stairwell were decorated with painted portraits of ordinary people

events.summary: Tyvar's climb leads back into the same library, where Zimone waits.
events.quote: He was back in the library.

events.summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
events.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

events.summary: Niko and the Wanderer enter a freezing meat locker with hanging carcasses.
events.quote: heavy iron chains hanging from the ceiling, the hooks at their ends driven into massive cuts of meat

events.summary: A stranger yanks Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass, just before a masked figure appears.
events.quote: yanked them hard behind the nearest hanging, flensed behemoth

events.summary: A tall razorkin with a cleaver stalks through the carcasses toward them.
events.quote: a figure came stalking through the carcasses, tall and wiry.

events.summary: Winter lures the razorkin into a beartrap by rattling a chain and leads Niko and the Wanderer out.
events.quote: only to step into a beartrap that had been concealed by the fog on the floor.

events.summary: Winter explains razorkin from the Floodpits track sound and that fighting one head-on would lose.
events.quote: The ones you find in the Floodpits aren't used to hearing sounds not echoed through water.

events.summary: Winter tells them he has lived in the House most of his life and that the House is the whole world.
events.quote: The House is the world, and the world is the House, and once it has hold of you, there's nowhere else to go.

relations.note: Taught him to read the air.
relations.quote: Under his tutelage, Kaito had learned how to step into a room

relations.note: She says she killed Nashi's mother, who had been taken by Phyrexia; Tamiyo is not named on this page.
relations.quote: I was sorry to kill her.
His mother was very dear to me, and I owe his family a great debt.

relations.note: Rescues her and Niko and leads them out of the locker.
relations.quote: The stranger pocketed his slingshot before gesturing for the others to follow him

relations.note: Has lived there most of his life.
relations.quote: And how long have you lived in the House, Winter?

relations.note: Keeps her from jumping after Kaito.
relations.quote: Not even for Kaito. He's the only one of us who can get out on his own.

relations.note: Chases him to keep the party together.
relations.quote: Tyvar, come back! We have to stay together!

relations.note: Winter says they are found there.
relations.quote: The ones you find in the Floodpits
